description: This file defines data models for a Ludo game, including enums, immutable classes with specific game-related properties (like PiecePosition variants, LudoPieceId, LudoMove, GameState) and their associated logic.

classes.name: LudoPieceId
classes.description: Immutable identifier for a Ludo piece, combining color and number.

classes.name: PiecePosition
classes.description: Sealed class representing different positions of a Ludo piece on the board.

classes.name: _Yard
classes.description: Represents a yard position in PiecePosition.

classes.name: _Track
classes.description: Represents a track position with an index in PiecePosition.

classes.name: _HomeStretch
classes.description: Represents a home stretch position with an index in PiecePosition.

classes.name: LudoMove
classes.description: Immutable class encapsulating a move by a specific piece with dice value.

classes.name: GameState
classes.description: Represents current state of the game including piece positions, active player, dice, and game status.

methods.name: __Track
methods.description: Constructor for Track position with index.

methods.name: __HomeStretch
methods.description: Constructor for HomeStretch position with index.

methods.name: when
methods.description: Pattern matching method for PiecePosition variants.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Method to create a copy of GameState with optional modifications.
